driver: STM32N6 CRC calculation unit (CRC) low-level (LL) driver as delivered by ST (STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0)

source_documents: RM0486 Rev 4 chapter 26 (CRC) + memory map p.176
target.hsi_contract: RM0486 Rev 4 ch.26 CRC register interface + memory map p.176 (CRC secure base 0x56024C00)
target.safety_allocation: NOT_PROVIDED: no owner safety scope recorded for the CRC benchmark work orders

scope: LL (header-only, __STATIC_INLINE functions) as delivered by ST: register access through the CMSIS device structure CRC (stm32n6xx.h)

Reset the calculation unit (CRC_CR.RESET); set the polynomial size (CRC_CR.POLYSIZE), the input reversal mode (CRC_CR.REV_IN with its reversal type CRC_CR.RTYPE_IN) and the output reversal mode (CRC_CR.REV_OUT with its reversal type CRC_CR.RTYPE_OUT), the initial value (CRC_INIT) and the polynomial coefficients (CRC_POL)
Feed a 32-bit data word and read the current CRC (CRC_DR); write and read the independent data register (CRC_IDR)
Out of scope: HAL API, 8-bit and 16-bit data register accesses, DMA, the LL init/deinit functions of stm32n6xx_ll_crc.c

budgets.status: development targets set by the work-order owner (2026-10-15), reused for the feature 015 benchmark set (2026-10-25)

guideline: inputs/hal_driver_guideline.md (ST Cube2 HAL SAD v1.2; automated subset = checklist SWE3-07)
layer_note: Feature 015 benchmark set (owner 2026-10-25): ST's existing STM32CubeN6 CRC LL code (stm32n6xx-hal-driver v1.4.0), FROZEN. Requirements are derived from RM0486 independently of the code; secure build (CMSIS selects CRC_S at 0x56024C00).

scope.note: calculation unit reset, polynomial size/coefficients, initial value, input/output reversal, 32-bit data feed and read, independent data register
